Tail the ledger in real time (M9.5 live-mode streaming).

Polls `list_events_after` in a loop and emits one event per line (NDJSON when `--format json|ndjson`, pretty text otherwise). Exits cleanly after `--max-events` events, on SIGINT (Ctrl-C), or after `--idle-timeout-ms` of no new events (default: never).

Usage: sddk ledger watch [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --root <ROOT>
          Checkout or worktree root. When absent and `--no-infer` is not set, the cycle inference layer walks up from cwd searching for a project marker (sddk manifest, .git, AGENTS.md). When `no_infer` is true, this must be provided explicitly

      --scope <SCOPE>
          Required monorepo scope, using `.` for the repository root. When absent and `--no-infer` is not set, inferred from the resolved root

      --remote <REMOTE>
          Explicit remote URL instead of read-only Git discovery

      --fallback-seed <FALLBACK_SEED>
          Stable UUID for a repository without a remote

      --no-infer
          Opt out of context inference. When set, `--root` and `--scope` must be passed explicitly and `--cycle` is a required argument on cycle commands

      --from-sequence <FROM_SEQUENCE>
          Start tailing after this ledger sequence. Default 0 (emit everything from the beginning). Use `--from-tail` instead to start after the current latest sequence (ignore existing events)
          
          [default: 0]

      --from-tail
          Start tailing strictly after the current latest sequence. Useful for live-streaming new events without re-emitting historical ones

      --frame <FRAME>
          Restrict to events sharing one command frame

      --cycle <CYCLE>
          Restrict to events for one cycle

      --interval-ms <INTERVAL_MS>
          Poll interval in milliseconds
          
          [default: 500]

      --max-events <MAX_EVENTS>
          Cap on events emitted before exiting (0 = unlimited)
          
          [default: 0]

      --idle-timeout-ms <IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS>
          Exit after this many milliseconds with no new events (0 = never)
          
          [default: 0]

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: `text` (pretty per-line), `json` or `ndjson` (one JSON object per line, no pretty-printing)

          Possible values:
          - text: Human-friendly text rendering
          - json: Machine-readable JSON envelope
          
          [default: text]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
